name: onca-pdv
author: ONÇA Produtos de Limpeza
description: ONÇA PDV — sistema profissional de ponto de venda local-first.

scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test:web
scripts.desktop:prepare:win: PDV_DESKTOP_PLATFORM=win node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-resources.mjs win
scripts.desktop:prepare:linux: PDV_DESKTOP_PLATFORM=linux node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-resources.mjs linux
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare:linux && npm run desktop:dist:linux
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare:win && npm run desktop:dist:win && npm run desktop:portable:readme && node scripts/pack-pendrive-zip.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare:linux && npm run desktop:dist:linux && npm run desktop:linux:portable
scripts.validate:etapa3: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run review:etapa1 && npm run review:etapa2 && npm run review:etapa3 && npm run e2e:etapa3 && npm run e2e:ui:etapa3
scripts.validate:etapa4: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run review:etapa1 && npm run review:etapa2 && npm run review:etapa3 && npm run review:etapa4 && npm run e2e:etapa4
scripts.validate:etapa5: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run review:etapa1 && npm run review:etapa2 && npm run review:etapa3 && npm run review:etapa4 && npm run review:etapa5 && npm run etapa5:test-data && npm run etapa5:restore-isolated && npm run e2e:etapa5 && npm run e2e:ui:etapa5
